answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ocean of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The bridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the anchor of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
